name: Brand strategy creation
prompt: Define our brand strategy and archetype.
expected_behavior: Checks for .agents/<productname>/product.md context
Performs deep web research on competitors and positioning trends
Presents summary and asks 2-4 validation questions
Outputs Brand Strategy document
Uses Kapferer's Brand Identity Prism
Identifies Jungian Archetype
References brand-strategy-framework.md

name: Brand voice and tone definition
prompt: What should our brand voice and tone of voice be?
expected_behavior: Derives voice from the chosen archetype and brand DNA
Gives 3-5 voice adjectives plus do/don't examples
Makes the voice usable by a copywriter without follow-up
Differentiates the voice from direct competitors

name: Golden Circle / brand purpose
prompt: Help us articulate our Why, How, and What.
expected_behavior: Applies Sinek's Golden Circle (Why/How/What)
Connects the Why directly through to the What
Grounds the purpose in the real product and audience, not platitudes
Avoids generic mission-statement filler

name: Messaging pillars
prompt: Give us our core messaging pillars.
expected_behavior: Defines 3 messaging pillars tied to the brand strategy
Provides a rationale and proof direction for each pillar
Ensures pillars are distinct and non-overlapping
Hands off to creative-copylines for execution

name: Archetype distinctiveness check
prompt: Is our brand archetype different enough from our competitors?
expected_behavior: Researches competitors' apparent archetypes
Assesses whether the chosen archetype is distinguishable
Recommends a sharper or secondary archetype if too crowded
Commits to ONE primary archetype rather than hedging
